51338597.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length human N-terminal His-tagged/GST-tagged Naa50 expressed in Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) cells in by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) using a CM5 sensor chip. The full-length human N-terminal His-tagged/GST-tagged Naa50 protein was immobilized on the chip via amine coupling. The immobilization level was approximately 1000 response units (RU). The running buffer was 25 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.02% Tween 20, 0.5 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol, 2% DMSO, pH 7.5. Compounds were diluted in the running buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 1000 nM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted 120 s, followed by a 300 s dissociation phase. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine-HCl, pH 2.0, for 30 s. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software. The binding kinetics were determined by fitting the sensorgrams to a 1:1 Langmuir binding model. The dissociation half-life (t1/2) was calculated as ln(2)/koff. The SPR Kd values were calculated as koff/kon. The experiments were performed at 10 °C.
original_paragraph.Table 1 caption: Measured at 10 °C in 25 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.5 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol, 0.02% Tween 20, 2% DMSO, pH 7.5.
original_paragraph.Figure 5 caption: Crystal structures of the complex of Naa50 with CoA and 3a (2.16 Å, PDB ID 6WFG) (a) or 4a (1.87 Å, PDB ID 6WFK) (b). CoA is drawn in yellow stick representation, 3a in blue stick representation, and 4a in magenta stick representation. Residues that form hydrogen bond interactions (dashed lines) that are common to both 3a and 4a are drawn as green sticks, while those that are unique to each ligand are drawn as orange sticks.
original_paragraph.Figure 6 caption: Crystal structure of the complex of 4a with Naa50 in the presence of AcCoA (1.07 Å, PDB ID 6WFN). View from the top of the binding pocket. AcCoA is drawn in pale blue stick representation while 4a is in magenta stick representation. The binding mode and hydrogen bonds (dashed lines) between 4a and Naa50 are identical to those observed in the presence of CoA.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 25 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.02% Tween 20, 0.5 mM TCEP, 5% glycerol, 2% DMSO, pH 7.5
